title: Byte Pack
text: Convert input signals to uint8 vector, 1 input, 1 output; {Input port data types (cell array)} sets the data types of block input signals and {Byte alignment} sets the byte boundary for data type alignment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signals to convert signal of type double (default) | array of signal data

params.name: Input port data types (cell array)
params.values: Data types of block input signals {’double’} (default) | cell array of Simulink ® data types

params.name: Byte alignment
params.values: Byte boundary for data type alignment 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8
